texts.en:
Orbital Rings are vast £megastructure£ Megastructures which are built to encircle an entire £planet£ Planet. They make for an efficient bridge between space and the planet below, providing room for facilities like Shipyards, defensive structures, and resource hubs.

The Orbital Ring view is where we can add or remove £building£ Buildings and Modules, as well as upgrade the Orbital Ring to higher tiers. Upgrading tiers increases the number of slots we have available to build in. Tiers are limited by colony infrastructure.
